name: Clozapine
summary: Clozapine, sold under the brand name Clozaril among others, is a psychiatric medication and was the first atypical antipsychotic to be discovered. It is used primarily to treat people with schizophrenia and schizoaffective disorder who have had an inadequate response to two other antipsychotics, or who have been unable to tolerate other drugs due to extrapyramidal side effects.

pharmacology.text: Clozapine is classified as an atypical antipsychotic drug because it binds to serotonin as well as dopamine receptors. It acts as an antagonist at both receptors. Clozapine is an inverse agonist at the 5-HT2A subtype of the serotonin receptor, putatively improving depression, anxiety, and the negative cognitive symptoms associated with schizophrenia.

Liver, by several CYP isozymes mainly via CYP2D6
80% in metabolized state: 30% biliary and 50% kidney

uses.text: Clozapine, sold under the brand name Clozaril among others, is a psychiatric medication and was the first atypical antipsychotic to be discovered. It is used primarily to treat people with schizophrenia and schizoaffective disorder who have had an inadequate response to two other antipsychotics, or who have been unable to tolerate other drugs due to extrapyramidal side effects.

sideEffects.text: Common adverse effects include drowsiness, constipation, hypersalivation (increased saliva production), tachycardia, low blood pressure, blurred vision, significant weight gain, and dizziness. Serious adverse effects include agranulocytosis, seizures, myocarditis (inflammation of the heart), and hyperglycemia (high blood glucose levels).

summaryZh: 氯氮平，常見商品名 Clozaril，為一種非典型抗精神病藥物。主要用於治療其他精神科藥物治療無效的精神分裂症。精神分裂症及分裂情感性障礙用藥可能會增加自殺的機會。本品藥效較其他典型抗精神病藥物為強，因此可用於治療對於其他藥物產生抗性的患者。本品由口服給藥。
summaryZhHans: 氯氮平，常见商品名 Clozaril，为一种非典型抗精神病药物。主要用于治疗其他精神科药物治疗无效的精神分裂症。精神分裂症及分裂情感性障碍用药可能会增加自杀的机会。本品药效较其他典型抗精神病药物为强，因此可用于治疗对于其他药物产生抗性的患者。本品由口服给药。

fact.en: Clozapine was first made in 1958 by the Swiss company Wander. It was withdrawn in many countries after deaths from a blood disorder in Finland in 1975, then brought back in the late 1980s with regular blood tests once it proved to work when other antipsychotics failed.
fact.zh: 氯氮平在 1958 年由瑞士 Wander 公司首次合成。1975 年芬蘭發生因血液疾病致死的案例後，它在許多國家被撤下；直到 1980 年代後期證實它在其他抗精神病藥無效時仍有效，才在搭配定期抽血檢查的條件下重新上市。
fact.zhHans: 氯氮平在 1958 年由瑞士 Wander 公司首次合成。1975 年芬兰发生因血液疾病致死的案例后，它在许多国家被撤下；直到 1980 年代后期证实它在其他抗精神病药无效时仍有效，才在搭配定期抽血检查的条件下重新上市。
